units.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
units.text: 1. Failure by the master of a seagoing vessel, an inland waterway vessel or another floating craft to comply with the rules for recording in the ship's documents operations involving substances harmful to human health or the living resources of the sea or other water bodies, or mixtures containing such substances above established limits, as well as making incorrect entries concerning those operations in the ship's documents —

units.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two…”

units.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
units.text: 2. Failure by the master of a vessel harvesting (catching) aquatic biological (living) resources in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation to fulfil the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to keep a fishing logbook, as well as entering distorted information therein —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8.16

units.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
